notes: Background: mid-market B2B SaaS (productivity stack). Heavy chat + retrieval + rerank features in product. Evaluated Redwood hosted API during Q4 2025, now negotiating Dedicated for production.

Initial ask: 99th pctile < 250ms for short-chat flows (prompt+response up to 1k tokens). Embeddings latency < 300ms per request desired for UI search. Throughput target: sustained ~120 reqs/s across cluster at peak.

Cost sensitivity: unit economics narrow: target ARR impact positive only if inference cost < $0.004/token equivalent for main use-case. Looking for predictable monthly commit + burst credits to avoid large overages.
Model preference: prefer Redwood-curated Llama-family quantized variants for cost, need a fallback chain to smaller models during capacity pressure (e.g., 70B -> 13B -> 7B).
Security: must run in customer VPC for PII routing; SOC2 + SSO (SAML) required. Audit logs retention 12 months. KMS integration mandatory for key handling.

Quote from CTO (2/28 POC wrap): "POC perf looks promising; the key is a pricing structure that lets us ramp without huge upfront risk. If Redwood can offer a ramp + limited overage buffer we can move forward."

Pricing ask details: seeking 12-month committed GPU-hours equivalence (approx. 3x baseline in month1 -> 6x by month3 ramp). Requesting burst allowance of 2.5x baseline sustained for 72 hours per month before overage kicks in. Overage pricing tiers requested (0-10% at discounted rate, >10% standard rate).

POC notes (2/01–2/28): ran hosted API sample load and migrated POC to dedicated trial. Measured average token cost improvement ~28% on dedicated trial with automatic KV caching enabled. Certain long-context kernels still need tuning (SE follow-up).
Commercial history: hosted API trial (Nov 2025) -> positive product fit -> dedicated demo (Jan 2026) -> POC (Feb 2026) -> pricing proposal (Mar 5 2026).
Legal/compliance: NDA executed, security questionnaire in progress. Legal asked for explicit termination & data-retention language on dedicated contract.
Integration notes: engineering team requests a 4-week sandbox onboarding window and access to console metrics (token-level billing + latency breakdown).
Internal Redwood asks: final committed QPS/peak token estimates, approved ramp schedule, list of EU data residency requirements (if any).

Sales tactician: propose 12mo commit with 3-month ramp (month1: 30% commit, month2: 60%, month3: 100%), 2.5x burst pool with 10% discounted overage band, credits for first-month PO deployment support.
